description: This file defines the LeaveReportDataAPI class within the OrangeHRM HR management system, responsible for handling API requests related to leave report data. It includes API endpoint documentation and a method to retrieve the appropriate report class based on input parameters.

classes.name: LeaveReportDataAPI
classes.description: API class providing access to leave report data, extending the core ReportDataAPI class and including Swagger/OpenAPI documentation annotations.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves the report class instance corresponding to the report name parameter, throwing a BadRequestException if the report name is invalid.
